title: WorkPulse performance.goal_activated v1
description: A draft employee goal was activated and is now in progress. Identifiers and the state only — goal titles and descriptions are sensitive and never leave the database (`.ai/security.md`).

employee_id.description: Employee the goal belongs to — the subject (UUIDv7 string). Also the Kafka message key (ADR 0012).

status.description: Goal state after activation; only active goals can complete.
